THE BANNERHOLD · AETHELGARD
The clan steading — site and outer territory (440 × 400 m modelled terrain)
First-pass layout for the shared pipeline
Right-handed, Y-up, metres · +X east · +Z south · origin = settlement datum · drawn from the blueprint data · names are working placeholders
TERRAIN LOGIC
A moraine knoll (≈ +12 m) on the north-west side of a glacial river valley. Its top is levelled at +10 m for the
compound and ringed by a palisade bank and ditch; the levy field is a terrace at +5.5 m on the south shoulder, 4.5 m
below the gate apron, reached by a ramp raking along the rampart. A steep forested fell climbs from a saddle (+7 m, with
the spring) 60 m to crags within 50 m; the stone ring stands on a ledge cut into its foot north-east of the compound at
+10.5 m. The river runs from the north-east past the knoll's foot (≈ −4 m) to the south-west, shallow at the ford below
the levy terrace, with the valley road on the far bank.

ATMOSPHERE
Late afternoon in a cold upland: a low sun from the south-west under a broken cloud ceiling, mist pooling along the
river. Key light from 235° at 14° (veiled-sun); fog 180–2400 m; wind toward 60° at 6 m/s.
